notes: W4-4 guard (CR 603.10a, 704.5d). Basri's Lieutenant: 'Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, if it had a +1/+1 counter on it, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.' A Soldier TOKEN with one +1/+1 counter dies to 2 damage. State-based actions now run before the trigger resolves, and a token in the graveyard ceases to exist as one of them; the engine keeps the token until the triggers its death caused have resolved, so the Lieutenant still sees that it had the counter and makes a Knight. Then the token is gone.
